000100******************************************************************
000200* PROGRAM     : CBACT01C.CBL
000300* Application : CardDemo
000400* Type        : BATCH COBOL Program
000500* FUNCTION    : READ THE ACCOUNT FILE AND WRITE INTO FILES.
000600******************************************************************
000700* Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates.
000800* All Rights Reserved.
000900*

001900* either express or implied. See the License for the specific
002000* language governing permissions and limitations under the License
002100******************************************************************
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID.    CBACT01C.
       AUTHOR.        AWS.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT ACCTFILE-FILE ASSIGN TO ACCTFILE
                  ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
                  ACCESS MODE  IS SEQUENTIAL
                  RECORD KEY   IS FD-ACCT-ID
                  FILE STATUS  IS ACCTFILE-STATUS.
      *
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
                  ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
                  ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
                  FILE STATUS IS OUTFILE-STATUS.
      *
           SELECT ARRY-FILE ASSIGN TO ARRYFILE
                  ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
                  ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
                  FILE STATUS IS ARRYFILE-STATUS.
      *
           SELECT VBRC-FILE ASSIGN TO VBRCFILE
                  ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
                  ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
                  FILE STATUS IS VBRCFILE-STATUS.
      *
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  ACCTFILE-FILE.
       01  FD-ACCTFILE-REC.
           05 FD-ACCT-ID                        PIC 9(11).
           05 FD-ACCT-DATA                      PIC X(289).
       FD OUT-FILE.
       01 OUT-ACCT-REC.
          05  OUT-ACCT-ID                PIC 9(11).
          05  OUT-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS     PIC X(01).
          05  OUT-ACCT-CURR-BAL          PIC S9(10)V99.
          05  OUT-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT      PIC S9(10)V99.
          05  OUT-ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT PIC S9(10)V99.
          05  OUT-ACCT-OPEN-DATE         PIC X(10).
          05  OUT-ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE    PIC X(10).
          05  OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE      PIC X(10).
          05  OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT   PIC S9(10)V99.
          05  OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT    PIC S9(10)V99
                                         USAGE IS COMP-3.
          05  OUT-ACCT-GROUP-ID          PIC X(10).
      *
       FD ARRY-FILE.
       01 ARR-ARRAY-REC.
          05  ARR-ACCT-ID                PIC 9(11).
          05  ARR-ACCT-BAL OCCURS 5  TIMES.
            10  ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL        PIC S9(10)V99.
            10  ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT  PIC S9(10)V99
                                         USAGE IS COMP-3.
          05  ARR-FILLER                 PIC X(04).
      *
       FD VBRC-FILE
                  RECORDING MODE IS V
                  RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE
                  FROM 10 TO 80 DEPENDING
                  ON WS-RECD-LEN.
       01 VBR-REC                        PIC X(80).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

      ****0************************************************************
       COPY CVACT01Y.
       COPY CODATECN.
       01  ACCTFILE-STATUS.
           05  ACCTFILE-STAT1      PIC X.
           05  ACCTFILE-STAT2      PIC X.
       01  OUTFILE-STATUS.
           05  OUTFILE-STAT1       PIC X.
           05  OUTFILE-STAT2       PIC X.
       01  ARRYFILE-STATUS.
           05  ARRYFILE-STAT1      PIC X.
           05  ARRYFILE-STAT2      PIC X.
       01  VBRCFILE-STATUS.
           05  VBRCFILE-STAT1      PIC X.
           05  VBRCFILE-STAT2      PIC X.

       01  IO-STATUS.
           05  IO-STAT1            PIC X.
           05  IO-STAT2            PIC X.
       01  TWO-BYTES-BINARY        PIC 9(4) BINARY.
       01  TWO-BYTES-ALPHA         REDEFINES TWO-BYTES-BINARY.
           05  TWO-BYTES-LEFT      PIC X.
           05  TWO-BYTES-RIGHT     PIC X.
       01  IO-STATUS-04.
           05  IO-STATUS-0401      PIC 9   VALUE 0.
           05  IO-STATUS-0403      PIC 999 VALUE 0.

       01  APPL-RESULT             PIC S9(9)   COMP.
           88  APPL-AOK            VALUE 0.
           88  APPL-EOF            VALUE 16.

       01  END-OF-FILE             PIC X(01)    VALUE 'N'.
       01  ABCODE                  PIC S9(9) BINARY.
       01  TIMING                  PIC S9(9) BINARY.
       01  WS-RECD-LEN             PIC  9(04).
       01 VBRC-REC1.
          05  VB1-ACCT-ID                PIC 9(11).
          05  VB1-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS     PIC X(01).
       01 VBRC-REC2.
          05  VB2-ACCT-ID                PIC 9(11).
          05  VB2-ACCT-CURR-BAL          PIC S9(10)V99.
          05  VB2-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT      PIC S9(10)V99.
          05  VB2-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY      PIC X(04).
       01 WS-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE.
          05  WS-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY       PIC X(04).
          05  WS-FILLER-1                PIC X(01).
          05  WS-ACCT-REISSUE-MM         PIC X(02).
          05  WS-FILLER-2                PIC X(01).
          05  WS-ACCT-REISSUE-DD         PIC X(02).
       01 WS-REISSUE-DATE REDEFINES WS-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE  PIC X(10).

      *****************************************************************
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT01C'.
           PERFORM 0000-ACCTFILE-OPEN.
           PERFORM 2000-OUTFILE-OPEN.
           PERFORM 3000-ARRFILE-OPEN.
           PERFORM 4000-VBRFILE-OPEN.

           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'
               IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
                   PERFORM 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT
                   IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
                       DISPLAY ACCOUNT-RECORD
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM.

           PERFORM 9000-ACCTFILE-CLOSE.

           DISPLAY 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT01C'.

           GOBACK.

      *****************************************************************
      * I/O ROUTINES TO ACCESS A KSDS, VSAM DATA SET...               *
      *****************************************************************
       1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT.
           READ ACCTFILE-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD.
           IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS = '00'
               MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
               INITIALIZE ARR-ARRAY-REC
               PERFORM 1100-DISPLAY-ACCT-RECORD
               PERFORM 1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD
               PERFORM 1350-WRITE-ACCT-RECORD
               PERFORM 1400-POPUL-ARRAY-RECORD
               PERFORM 1450-WRITE-ARRY-RECORD
               INITIALIZE VBRC-REC1
               PERFORM 1500-POPUL-VBRC-RECORD
               PERFORM 1550-WRITE-VB1-RECORD
               PERFORM 1575-WRITE-VB2-RECORD
           ELSE
               IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS = '10'
                   MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT
               ELSE
                   MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF  APPL-AOK
               CONTINUE
           ELSE
               IF  APPL-EOF
                   MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE
               ELSE
                   DISPLAY 'ERROR READING ACCOUNT FILE'
                   MOVE ACCTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
                   PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
                   PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
               END-IF
           END-IF
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       1100-DISPLAY-ACCT-RECORD.
           DISPLAY 'ACCT-ID                 :'   ACCT-ID
           DISPLAY 'ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS      :'   ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS
           DISPLAY 'ACCT-CURR-BAL           :'   ACCT-CURR-BAL
           DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT       :'   ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
           DISPLAY 'ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT  :'   ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT
           DISPLAY 'ACCT-OPEN-DATE          :'   ACCT-OPEN-DATE
           DISPLAY 'ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE     :'   ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE
           DISPLAY 'ACCT-REISSUE-DATE       :'   ACCT-REISSUE-DATE
           DISPLAY 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT    :'   ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
           DISPLAY 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT     :'   ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
           DISPLAY 'ACCT-GROUP-ID           :'   ACCT-GROUP-ID
           DISPLAY '-------------------------------------------------'
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD.
           MOVE   ACCT-ID                 TO   OUT-ACCT-ID.
           MOVE   ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS      TO   OUT-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS.
           MOVE   ACCT-CURR-BAL           TO   OUT-ACCT-CURR-BAL.
           MOVE   ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT       TO   OUT-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT.
           MOVE   ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT  TO OUT-ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT.
           MOVE   ACCT-OPEN-DATE          TO   OUT-ACCT-OPEN-DATE.
           MOVE   ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE     TO   OUT-ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE.
           MOVE   ACCT-REISSUE-DATE       TO   CODATECN-INP-DATE
                                               WS-REISSUE-DATE.
           MOVE   '2'                     TO   CODATECN-TYPE.
           MOVE   '2'                     TO   CODATECN-OUTTYPE.

      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
      *CALL ASSEMBLER PROGRAM FOR DATE FORMATTING                     *
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
           CALL 'COBDATFT'       USING CODATECN-REC.

           MOVE   CODATECN-0UT-DATE       TO   OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE.

           MOVE   ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT    TO   OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT.
           IF  ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT EQUAL TO ZERO
               MOVE 2525.00         TO   OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
           END-IF.
           MOVE   ACCT-GROUP-ID           TO   OUT-ACCT-GROUP-ID.
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       1350-WRITE-ACCT-RECORD.
           WRITE OUT-ACCT-REC.

           IF OUTFILE-STATUS NOT = '00' AND OUTFILE-STATUS NOT = '10'
              DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT FILE WRITE STATUS IS:'  OUTFILE-STATUS
              MOVE OUTFILE-STATUS  TO IO-STATUS
              PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
              PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
           END-IF.
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       1400-POPUL-ARRAY-RECORD.
           MOVE   ACCT-ID         TO   ARR-ACCT-ID.
           MOVE   ACCT-CURR-BAL   TO   ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(1).
           MOVE   1005.00         TO   ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(1).
           MOVE   ACCT-CURR-BAL   TO   ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(2).
           MOVE   1525.00         TO   ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(2).
           MOVE   -1025.00        TO   ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(3).
           MOVE   -2500.00        TO   ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(3).
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       1450-WRITE-ARRY-RECORD.
           WRITE ARR-ARRAY-REC.

           IF ARRYFILE-STATUS NOT = '00'
                        AND ARRYFILE-STATUS NOT = '10'
              DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT FILE WRITE STATUS IS:'
                                        ARRYFILE-STATUS
              MOVE ARRYFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
              PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
              PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
           END-IF.
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       1500-POPUL-VBRC-RECORD.
           MOVE   ACCT-ID            TO VB1-ACCT-ID
                                        VB2-ACCT-ID.
           MOVE   ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS TO VB1-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS.
           MOVE   ACCT-CURR-BAL           TO  VB2-ACCT-CURR-BAL.
           MOVE   ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT       TO  VB2-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT.
           MOVE   WS-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY    TO  VB2-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY.
           DISPLAY 'VBRC-REC1:' VBRC-REC1.
           DISPLAY 'VBRC-REC2:' VBRC-REC2.
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       1550-WRITE-VB1-RECORD.
           MOVE 12 TO WS-RECD-LEN.
           MOVE VBRC-REC1 TO VBR-REC(1:WS-RECD-LEN).
           WRITE VBR-REC.

           IF VBRCFILE-STATUS NOT = '00'
                        AND VBRCFILE-STATUS NOT = '10'
              DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT FILE WRITE STATUS IS:'
                                        VBRCFILE-STATUS
              MOVE VBRCFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
              PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
              PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
           END-IF.
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       1575-WRITE-VB2-RECORD.
           MOVE 39 TO WS-RECD-LEN.
           MOVE VBRC-REC2 TO VBR-REC(1:WS-RECD-LEN).
           WRITE VBR-REC.

           IF VBRCFILE-STATUS NOT = '00'
                        AND VBRCFILE-STATUS NOT = '10'
              DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT FILE WRITE STATUS IS:'
                                        VBRCFILE-STATUS
              MOVE VBRCFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
              PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
              PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
           END-IF.
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       0000-ACCTFILE-OPEN.
           MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT.
           OPEN INPUT ACCTFILE-FILE
           IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS = '00'
               MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
           ELSE
               MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT
           END-IF
           IF  APPL-AOK
               CONTINUE
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING ACCTFILE'
               MOVE ACCTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
               PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
               PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
           END-IF
           EXIT.
       2000-OUTFILE-OPEN.
           MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT.
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           IF   OUTFILE-STATUS = '00'
               MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
           ELSE
               MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT
           END-IF
           IF  APPL-AOK
               CONTINUE
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING OUTFILE'  OUTFILE-STATUS
               MOVE  OUTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
               PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
               PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
           END-IF
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       3000-ARRFILE-OPEN.
           MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT.
           OPEN OUTPUT ARRY-FILE
           IF   ARRYFILE-STATUS = '00'
               MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
           ELSE
               MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT
           END-IF
           IF  APPL-AOK
               CONTINUE
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING ARRAYFILE'  ARRYFILE-STATUS
               MOVE  ARRYFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
               PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
               PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
           END-IF
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       4000-VBRFILE-OPEN.
           MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT.
           OPEN OUTPUT VBRC-FILE
           IF   VBRCFILE-STATUS = '00'
               MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
           ELSE
               MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT
           END-IF
           IF  APPL-AOK
               CONTINUE
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING VBRC FILE'  VBRCFILE-STATUS
               MOVE  VBRCFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
               PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
               PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
           END-IF
           EXIT.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       9000-ACCTFILE-CLOSE.
           ADD 8 TO ZERO GIVING APPL-RESULT.
           CLOSE ACCTFILE-FILE
           IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS = '00'
               SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT
           ELSE
               ADD 12 TO ZERO GIVING APPL-RESULT
           END-IF
           IF  APPL-AOK
               CONTINUE
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'ERROR CLOSING ACCOUNT FILE'
               MOVE ACCTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
               PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
               PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
           END-IF
           EXIT.

       9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.
           DISPLAY 'ABENDING PROGRAM'
           MOVE 0 TO TIMING
           MOVE 999 TO ABCODE
           CALL 'CEE3ABD' USING ABCODE, TIMING.

      *****************************************************************
       9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS.
           IF  IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC
           OR  IO-STAT1 = '9'
               MOVE IO-STAT1 TO IO-STATUS-04(1:1)
               MOVE 0        TO TWO-BYTES-BINARY
               MOVE IO-STAT2 TO TWO-BYTES-RIGHT
               MOVE TWO-BYTES-BINARY TO IO-STATUS-0403
               DISPLAY 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' IO-STATUS-04
           ELSE
               MOVE '0000' TO IO-STATUS-04
               MOVE IO-STATUS TO IO-STATUS-04(3:2)
               DISPLAY 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' IO-STATUS-04
           END-IF
           EXIT.

package com.carddemo.cbact01c.batch; import java.math.BigDecimal; /** * Maps to OUT-FILE output record (FD OUT-FILE / OUT-ACCT-REC). * *

COBOL: CBACT01C.cbl:56-69 — FD OUT-FILE layout. * Populated by 1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD (CBACT01C.cbl:215-240). * *

Key transformation: {@link #reissueDate} holds the YYYYMMDD-formatted date * produced by the COBDATFT assembler call (see {@link DateConversionService}). */ public record OutRecord( Long acctId, // OUT-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) String activeStatus, // OUT-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS PIC X(01) BigDecimal currBal, // OUT-ACCT-CURR-BAL PIC S9(10)V99 BigDecimal creditLimit, // OUT-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT PIC S9(10)V99 BigDecimal cashCreditLimit,// OUT-ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT PIC S9(10)V99 String openDate, // OUT-ACCT-OPEN-DATE PIC X(10) String expirationDate, // OUT-ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE PIC X(10) String reissueDate, // OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE PIC X(10) — YYYYMMDD via COBDATFT BigDecimal currCycCredit, // OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT PIC S9(10)V99 BigDecimal currCycDebit, // OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT PIC S9(10)V99 COMP-3 (2525.00 if zero) String groupId // OUT-ACCT-GROUP-ID PIC X(10) ) {}

package com.carddemo.cbact01c.batch; /** * Groups all output records produced for one account in a single processing step. * *

Passed from {@link AccountExportProcessor} to {@link MultiFileItemWriter}. * Mirrors the four write calls in the CBACT01C main loop: * 

 * L172   PERFORM 1350-WRITE-ACCT-RECORD   → outRecord  → OUTFILE
 * L174   PERFORM 1450-WRITE-ARRY-RECORD   → arrayRecord → ARRYFILE
 * L177   PERFORM 1550-WRITE-VB1-RECORD    → vbrRecord1  → VBRCFILE
 * L178   PERFORM 1575-WRITE-VB2-RECORD    → vbrRecord2  → VBRCFILE
 *
*/ public record AccountExportBundle( OutRecord outRecord, ArrayRecord arrayRecord, VbrRecord1 vbrRecord1, VbrRecord2 vbrRecord2 ) {}

140.c: PROCEDURE DIVISION main flow — PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
140.n: The sequential read-loop is replaced by a paginated Step. Spring Batch handles paging, restartability, and chunk-level transactions automatically.

165.n: Sequential READ becomes a paginated JPA query ordered by acctId ASC, page size 10. Returning null signals EOF — equivalent to file status '10'.

200.n: All 11 DISPLAY statements become one SLF4J log.debug() call. Output is only visible at DEBUG log level — set logging.level.com.carddemo=DEBUG in application.yml.

215.n: Field-by-field MOVE statements become constructor arguments of a Java record. Immutability is guaranteed — no accidental overwrite bugs.

231.n: The IBM Assembler date formatter is replaced by java.time: LocalDate.parse(date, ISO_LOCAL_DATE).format(BASIC_ISO_DATE). TYPE=2 → YYYY-MM-DD in, OUTTYPE=2 → YYYYMMDD out.

236.c: IF ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT EQUAL TO ZERO  MOVE 2525.00 TO OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
236.n: The ternary mirrors the COBOL IF exactly. DEFAULT_CYC_DEBIT uses the BigDecimal String constructor — never use a double literal for financial values.

242.n: FlatFileItemWriter formats each OutRecord as a pipe-delimited line. Locale.US is mandatory — without it, German/French locales produce '1940,00' instead of '1940.00'.

253.c: 1400-POPUL-ARRAY-RECORD — MOVE values to ARR-ACCT-BAL OCCURS 5 TIMES
253.n: OCCURS 5 TIMES becomes a fixed List of 5 elements. INITIALIZE ARR-ARRAY-REC zeroes entries 4–5; the Java code sets those to BigDecimal.ZERO explicitly.

263.n: FlatFileItemWriter formats each ArrayRecord as: ACCT-ID followed by 5 × (|BAL|DEBIT) pairs using String.format(Locale.US, ...).

276.j: new VbrRecord1(acctId, activeStatus) + new VbrRecord2(acctId, currBal, creditLimit, year)
276.n: Two separate fixed-layout record types replace the REDEFINES trick. WS-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY (chars 1–4 of the date) becomes reissueDate.substring(0, 4).

287.n: Variable-length binary records (WS-RECD-LEN=12 / 39) become prefixed text lines. The VBR1|/VBR2| prefix replaces the implicit record-length descriptor used by RECORDING MODE IS V.

317.j: RepositoryItemReader.open() via Spring Batch ItemStream lifecycle
317.n: No explicit file open needed. Spring Batch calls open() before the step starts and close() after it ends — identical to COBOL OPEN/CLOSE semantics.

334.j: MultiFileItemWriter.open() — delegates to three FlatFileItemWriter instances
334.n: All output files are opened in a single ItemStream.open() call. Spring Batch registers MultiFileItemWriter as a stream via the step builder.

388.j: MultiFileItemWriter.close() — delegates to all three FlatFileItemWriter instances
388.n: Spring Batch calls close() during step teardown. All four files (ACCTFILE + 3 output files) are closed automatically through the ItemStream lifecycle.

406.n: No explicit error handler. Exception from reader/processor/writer propagates to Spring Batch, which marks the step FAILED and stores it in StepExecution.getFailureExceptions().

413.n: Two-byte VSAM file status codes (e.g. '35' = file not found) are translated by the exception message. No manual binary decoding needed — Java IO exceptions carry meaningful text.

ACCOUNT-RECORD.b: Full account record from VSAM ACCTDAT (300 bytes, keyed on ACCT-ID)

ACCT-ID.b: Account number — 11-digit unique credit-card account identifier

ACCT-CURR-BAL.b: Current outstanding balance on the account (signed, 2 decimal places)

ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT.b: Maximum credit line authorised for purchases

ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT.b: Sub-limit for cash advances (subset of the overall credit limit)

ACCT-OPEN-DATE.b: Date the account was opened (format YYYY-MM-DD)

ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE.b: Card expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD; "EXPIRAION" is a typo in the COBOL source)

ACCT-REISSUE-DATE.b: Date the card was last reissued (format YYYY-MM-DD)

ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT.b: Total credits posted in the current billing cycle

ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT.b: Total debits in the current billing cycle (COMP-3 packed decimal)

ACCT-ADDR-ZIP.b: Billing-address ZIP/postal code of the cardholder
ACCT-ADDR-ZIP.j: Account.addrZip (String) — column addr_zip (not in any output file)

FD-ACCTFILE-REC.b: File-section buffer for one VSAM input record (key + 289-byte payload)
FD-ACCTFILE-REC.j: No Java equivalent — Spring Batch reads rows via JPA; no file buffer needed

FD-ACCT-ID.b: VSAM KSDS record key used by COBOL to locate and sequence records
FD-ACCT-ID.j: No Java equivalent — JPA uses @Id on Account.acctId; key implicit in SQL

FD-ACCT-DATA.b: Raw 289-byte data portion of the VSAM record (PIC X(289))
FD-ACCT-DATA.j: No Java equivalent — Hibernate maps each column individually

OUT-ACCT-REC.b: Output record layout for the pipe-delimited OUTFILE sequential file

OUT-ACCT-ID.b: Account number in the OUTFILE record

OUT-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS.b: Active-status flag in the OUTFILE record

OUT-ACCT-CURR-BAL.b: Current balance in the OUTFILE record

OUT-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT.b: Credit limit in the OUTFILE record

OUT-ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT.b: Cash credit limit in the OUTFILE record

OUT-ACCT-OPEN-DATE.b: Open date in the OUTFILE record

OUT-ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE.b: Expiry date in the OUTFILE record

OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE.b: Reissue date in YYYYMMDD format — produced by COBDATFT assembler call

OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT.b: Billing-cycle credit total in the OUTFILE record

OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT.b: Billing-cycle debit total — replaced by 2525.00 when zero

OUT-ACCT-GROUP-ID.b: Group ID in the OUTFILE record

ARR-ARRAY-REC.b: Output record for ARRYFILE — account ID + 5 balance/debit entries

ARR-ACCT-ID.b: Account number in the ARRYFILE record

ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL.b: Current-balance component within one OCCURS entry

ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT.b: Cycle-debit component within one OCCURS entry (COMP-3 packed)

ARR-FILLER.b: 4-byte padding filler in the ARRYFILE record (PIC X(04))
ARR-FILLER.j: No Java equivalent — Java record fields carry no padding

VBR-REC.b: Variable-length record buffer written to VBRC-FILE (RECORDING MODE V, 10–80 bytes)
VBR-REC.j: No direct Java equivalent — MultiFileItemWriter.formatVbr1/formatVbr2() produce formatted strings

ACCTFILE-STATUS.b: 2-char I/O status after READ/OPEN/CLOSE on the VSAM account file ("00"=OK, "10"=EOF)
ACCTFILE-STATUS.j: No Java equivalent — Spring Batch throws on I/O error; null return signals EOF

OUTFILE-STATUS.b: 2-char I/O status after each WRITE on OUTFILE
OUTFILE-STATUS.j: No Java equivalent — FlatFileItemWriter throws ItemStreamException on error

ARRYFILE-STATUS.b: 2-char I/O status after each WRITE on ARRYFILE
ARRYFILE-STATUS.j: No Java equivalent — FlatFileItemWriter exception handling replaces status checks

VBRCFILE-STATUS.b: 2-char I/O status after each WRITE on VBRC-FILE
VBRCFILE-STATUS.j: No Java equivalent — exception propagation replaces status

IO-STATUS.b: Shared status holder — copied from file-specific status before 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
IO-STATUS.j: No Java equivalent — exceptions carry context directly

IO-STAT1.b: First byte of the shared IO-STATUS field

IO-STAT2.b: Second byte — mapped via TWO-BYTES-BINARY to a display integer

TWO-BYTES-BINARY.b: 2-byte binary integer used to decode numeric file-status codes for display
TWO-BYTES-BINARY.j: No Java equivalent — Java integer arithmetic replaces the REDEFINES trick

TWO-BYTES-LEFT.b: Left byte of the TWO-BYTES-ALPHA overlay

TWO-BYTES-RIGHT.b: Right byte — receives IO-STAT2 so TWO-BYTES-BINARY holds the numeric value

IO-STATUS-04.b: 4-character display string for the I/O error code shown in DISPLAY messages
IO-STATUS-04.j: No Java equivalent — error code included in exception message

IO-STATUS-0401.b: Leading character of the 4-char status display field

IO-STATUS-0403.b: Trailing 3-digit numeric portion of the status display field

APPL-RESULT.b: Generic return code (0=OK, 12=error, 16=EOF) set by every I/O paragraph
APPL-RESULT.j: No Java equivalent — Spring Batch uses null/exception for EOF/error

APPL-AOK.j: No Java equivalent — success is the absence of an exception

APPL-EOF.b: 88-level condition: fires when APPL-RESULT = 16 (end of file)
APPL-EOF.j: No Java equivalent — ItemReader.read() returns null to signal EOF

END-OF-FILE.b: Loop-termination flag — set to "Y" when the account file is exhausted
END-OF-FILE.j: No Java equivalent — Spring Batch chunk loop ends when ItemReader returns null

ABCODE.b: Abend code passed to CEE3ABD (999 = forced application abend)
ABCODE.j: No Java equivalent — replaced by unchecked exception; Spring Batch marks step FAILED

TIMING.b: Timing parameter for CEE3ABD call (0 = immediate abend)
TIMING.j: No Java equivalent — Java exception propagation is always synchronous

WS-RECD-LEN.b: Variable-record length for VBRC-FILE writes (12 for VBR-REC1, 39 for VBR-REC2)
WS-RECD-LEN.j: No Java equivalent — MultiFileItemWriter writes fixed-format prefixed strings

VBRC-REC1.b: Short VBR record: account ID (11) + active status (1) = 12 bytes

VB1-ACCT-ID.b: Account ID in the short VBR record

VB1-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS.b: Active status in the short VBR record

VBRC-REC2.b: Long VBR record: account ID + balance + credit limit + reissue year = 39 bytes

VB2-ACCT-ID.b: Account ID in the long VBR record

VB2-ACCT-CURR-BAL.b: Current balance in the long VBR record

VB2-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT.b: Credit limit in the long VBR record

VB2-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY.b: 4-char reissue year extracted from ACCT-REISSUE-DATE via REDEFINES overlay

WS-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE.b: Work area overlaid on ACCT-REISSUE-DATE to extract YYYY/MM/DD components
WS-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE.j: No Java equivalent — Java uses String.substring(); no overlay needed

WS-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY.b: Year portion of the reissue date (first 4 characters)

WS-FILLER-1.b: 1-byte filler for the "-" between year and month in the date work area
WS-FILLER-1.j: No Java equivalent — separator implicit in ISO-8601 string

WS-ACCT-REISSUE-MM.b: Month portion of the reissue date (2 characters)
WS-ACCT-REISSUE-MM.j: No direct Java variable — implicit in LocalDate.parse()

WS-FILLER-2.b: 1-byte filler for the "-" between month and day

WS-ACCT-REISSUE-DD.b: Day portion of the reissue date (2 characters)
WS-ACCT-REISSUE-DD.j: No direct Java variable — implicit in LocalDate.parse()

WS-REISSUE-DATE.b: REDEFINES overlay giving a single 10-char view of WS-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE
WS-REISSUE-DATE.j: No Java equivalent — date stored as plain String; no REDEFINES in Java

CODATECN-REC.b: Parameter record for the COBDATFT assembler date-formatting routine

CODATECN-INP-DATE.b: Input date string for COBDATFT (20 chars, receives ACCT-REISSUE-DATE)

CODATECN-TYPE.j: No Java equivalent — DateConversionService always expects YYYY-MM-DD

CODATECN-OUTTYPE.j: No Java equivalent — DateConversionService always produces YYYYMMDD

CODATECN-0UT-DATE.b: Formatted date returned by COBDATFT (20 chars, left-justified YYYYMMDD)

ACCTFILE-FILE.b: VSAM KSDS input file containing all account master records (ddname ACCTFILE)
ACCTFILE-FILE.j: AccountRepository (JPA) — accountReader() bean reads accounts table

OUT-FILE.b: Sequential output file for flat account export (ddname OUTFILE)

ARRY-FILE.b: Sequential output file for array-format balance records (ddname ARRYFILE)

VBRC-FILE.b: Variable-length sequential output file (ddname VBRCFILE, RECORDING MODE V)
